# Week-by-Week Salesforce Apex Trigger Developer Upskilling Curriculum

---

## Week 1: Introduction to Salesforce Platform and Apex Basics
- Overview of Salesforce CRM and platform architecture
- Introduction to Apex programming language: syntax, data types, and control structures
- Hands-on: Write simple Apex classes and anonymous Apex scripts
- Mini-Project: Create an Apex class to perform basic calculations and unit test it

## Week 2: Salesforce Data Model and SOQL
- Understanding Salesforce objects, fields, and relationships
- Introduction to Salesforce Object Query Language (SOQL)
- Hands-on: Query records using SOQL inside Apex
- Mini-Project: Build an Apex method to fetch and process Account and Contact records

## Week 3: Apex Triggers Fundamentals
- Concept and purpose of Apex triggers
- Trigger events: before insert, after insert, before update, after update, before delete, after delete, after undelete
- Best practices: bulkification, recursion control, and governor limits introduction
- Hands-on: Create simple triggers for Account and Contact objects
- Mini-Project: Develop triggers to enforce business rules on lead conversion

## Week 4: Trigger Context Variables and Execution Order
- In-depth look at trigger context variables (Trigger.new, Trigger.old, isInsert, isUpdate etc.)
- Order of execution in Salesforce
- Debugging and error handling in triggers
- Hands-on: Implement triggers with context variables and debug using logs
- Mini-Project: Implement a trigger that prevents duplicate record creation

## Week 5: Trigger Handler Pattern and Modular Design
- Understanding the Trigger Handler Class Pattern
- Refactoring triggers to separate logic from trigger events
- Dependency injection and unit testing of trigger handlers
- Hands-on: Create Trigger handlers and refactor existing triggers
- Mini-Project: Design a scalable trigger handler for Opportunity triggers

## Week 6: Advanced Topics in Triggers: Bulkification and Governor Limits
- Deep dive into governor limits and bulk processing
- Writing efficient bulkified Apex triggers
- Handling large data volumes gracefully
- Hands-on: Rewrite existing triggers to support bulk operations
- Mini-Project: Build a trigger that updates related records in bulk without exceeding limits

## Week 7: Integration and Platform Events
- Introduction to Event-Driven Architecture within Salesforce
- Platform events and their usage in Apex triggers
- Asynchronous Apex methods to optimize performance
- Hands-on: Create triggers that publish platform events
- Mini-Project: Implement a trigger-driven integration using platform events

## Week 8: Testing, Deployment, and Maintenance
- Writing comprehensive test classes for triggers and handler classes
- Maintaining code quality and adhering to Salesforce deployment best practices
- Managing API versions and migrating deprecated triggers beyond API version 20
- Hands-on: Write and execute test suites, update triggers to latest API versions
- Mini-Project: Prepare and deploy a complete trigger-based module to a sandbox environment

---

This 8-week program equips freshers with foundational to intermediate Salesforce Apex trigger skills emphasizing best practices, modular architectures, and compliance with current 2024 Salesforce development standards.
